what_this_is: the map of this folder of sources: where each source's file stands (paths are read against this folder), who gave it, at which revision. reader/tools/make-place-answers-v1.sh <this folder> makes the whole of data/place-answers-v1/ from these files and the tree's zones. To take a newer file of a source, put it here and change its path and revision below.

facts.provider: unfoldingWord, the Hebrew and Aramaic Lexicon (en_uhal), one file per Strong's number under content/

Read instead from the corpus lane's record file dictionary-store-v1/records/M7.jsonl, inside the lane's store part v2/corpus/dictionary-store/build/TEXT-PART-v1.tar.gz (sha256 f1c6b41ac9e371806a8b04c1724799d9246715c004890f2192e6a30134bee29c): one record per file of the lexicon the lane kept, the file whole, cached by the lane on 12 July 2026

uhal.not_on_hand: the lexicon has a file for every Strong's number; the 151 files the lane's record keeps are on hand (the files that carry a gloss). The rest are not on this machine
